## ANGANG UNABA (ANGANG POKPA) 

Panthou epa da tha ani, palem ema da tha tara noupuduna leiramlaga, emagi noupifamda leiba yadaduna, mapu mana thindokpiraktuna taibang lamjao faore (pokle), hek pokpaga nouwa adu eru-esengthokpigani aduga nahei lailonna angang adu sengdokkani. Pokliba nouwa aduna nupa oirabadi khoiri naofam adu yumgi kha-thangba_ fammen lomda fumgani. Nupi oiragana yumgi awang thangbada mangsok lomda fumgani. Mamagi humni khomdin laktriba faoba atoppa meegi khomlang pithakfaroi. Poklakeba angang khudingmak mamagi khomlang tamak pithakkadabani. Mama, macha animak epan youdriba faoba panthou epagi masak oiba koilou numit ki masak uhanfade. 
Mama amasung angang gi phee subada esingda laksinduna sufade, sugadouriba phee adu khudengda hanna haplaga phee mathakta esing heiraga suhani, hairiba thouram asi pokpa numittagi houna epan tarukni faoba pangthokkani. Masina angang esingda tabanachingba thokkande. 

## EPAN (TARUKNI) THOURAM

Ayuk anganbada mama amasung macha animak eru esengthokkani loinana nahei lailon sonduna yum sengdokkani. Ayukta epan thabagi thouram amasung pitai khomtaibi ema gi thouram tougani pokliba angang adugi mapana nattraga mapa marigi(mari-matagi) nupa amana angang aduda mingkhei ha,hung,hei,hae,hing haina pibigani, amasung nouwa angang aduna punsi lomdriba faobada kougadaba mingthol adu thonbigani.
Ten Kappa:- Chingkheidagi houna tenchei amamam kaptuna meiram faobada tenchei mari kapkani, tenchei amana nongthak amasung leikharomda utlamlaga emungda pusingani. Ten kapkadaba meedi poklakeba angang gi mamaga pokminnaba mabung nattraga mapuwana kokyet yetlaga kapkadabani. Angang aduda sen pibanachingba toufade, fambanda thounibigani. Mathanggi numitta famban kaigani.

## CHAKUMBA (TAIBANG CHINJAK CHABA) 

Nupina pokpadagi tha manga subada aduga nupana tha taruk subada taibang chinjak chaba houba oina chakumgani. 
Mama mapa amasung chakumgadouriba angang eru-esengduna nahei laisonna sengdokkani angang gi pheejol honggani.
Lainingthou sanamahee makaifamda athenpot ama ngamu yaona thellaga thounijagani, maduna thong-thaklaga chakumbagi thou pangthokkani.
Athongba chak yensang adu magi magi yek salaigi pu ahumda luk ahum thokna katkani. 
(Pu ahum hybadi:- eputhou pakhangba, salai, salaina pokpa) 
Lukman khara khara luk ahum adudagi louraga makhagi asumna mamana enbigani. Chak enbada mam-mam, esing enbada ku-ku hygani. Asumna taretlak chak en tamgani.

## NAHUT-NARENG

Nahut-narenggi thouram hybasi meetei enatki oina tangai fadraba toudaba yadaba thouram ama oina leiramdabana maram oiduna na hutpa pambiba meeoina numit-tha achangba yaifaba numit amada pangthokpiba yai. Yarabadi pokpa numittagi numit taruknigi manungda pangthokpibasu akaiba leite thouram asibu enat ka mari leinaba achouba thouram ama oina pangthoklubagi mathou tade.

## EPA KHA NGANPA

Eikhoi kangleipak meetei sing gi salai taret (7) lei makhoising adudi Mangang, Luwang , Khuman, Angom, Moilang, Khapa-nganpa, (Ka-nganpa) Salai Leisangthem 

Salai 7 asi kanglei ningthou ahanba houjik ki Imphal kanglada panlamba Konchin Tukthapa Epu Athoupa (Eputhou) Pakhangpa gi machasingni 

Kha-Nganpa haiba kanglei ningthou asi 6 suba macha nupa ni 
Kha-Nganpa bu pokpa leima palem adugi maming na Leitham Tali Leima kouw e 
Ema Ebemma Tali asi Eputhou Pakhangpa gi 6 suba loinabini

Kha -Nganpa na leilampa mafamsing di Imphal gi kangla gi konnungda, mapabung ebungo Pakhangpa ga leiramlaba matung, kha-Nganpa bu khaidoklakpa matamda, kha-Nganpa na ehan hanna tonganna leiramba mafamdi 'Salang Mai ' ni
Salai mai haiba mafam asi houjik ki kangla gi mafam amada oifam thok e
Ayebana mafam asi chap chana takpa ngamdre mathangda kha-Nganpa na Lailelpi Konting Leima ga luhonglaba matungda Nongtamlen Anganpa PoK a 

Matou asum touna meesing hengatlaklaba matamda Kangpokpi da leiramle, Mathangda Langol da leiram me, Mathangda Luwang Chingda Leiram me Ekon Konbada 'Takna Khana Konpa ' mafamda Leiram me

Salai taret ki machu gi manung da Kha-Nganpa ki machu di 'Lumna Nganpa Machu ni 

Eputhou Pakhangpa Konchin Tukthapa Ningthou gi matamda Salai 7 makki thijinlon puya amamam Leiram me makhoising adudi - Mangang lon, Luwang lon, Khumanlon, Angaomlon, Moilang lon, Kha-Nganpa lon, Salai Leisangthem lon asini

Puya mei thabada yaokhre loina mangkhre salailon sing asi fanglabadi salai taret ki matangda houfam satfam leifam salai machu pokpa gi matam ching gi meesing ga tamgi meesing ga leinaba mari, ching gi meesing gi salai asinachingba munna khanglamgadoubani adubu hindu gi matamda puya meithabana tumna manghankhre.

## KHUMAN

Kanglei meetei epa epu singi puya wakoklon heelel Thilel Salai Ama-elon pukok puya asi, kangleipak ki epa,epu singna hanna khnglamba, malemgi mee atei kanglup na houjikta khangba houriba science ki wafam na pik thalli. Masi nongma nongmagi mayek senglakpagum touri.

Houjik mathakta panjakhiba puya aduda eriba asi yenglagadi Malemgi Space ki manungda machu 7 lottuna lei haibasi ahanba haiba mee kanglup ti kangleicha meetei epa epu singni haibasi khngani.

Adubu 19 suba enggi chahi chada puthokpa chumthang gi machu 7 haibadi Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo and Violet machu taret asiga puyada eba machu 7 ka khetnei. Science na puthokpa machu 7 asi da "Amuba' machu yaode, nongchup lamgi ngarangda Science na puthokpa asidagi hanna kangleicha epa epu singna puthokpa machu 7 ti "Amuba' Machu yaoe. Karamna khetnaribano khangba ngmdri.

Houjik eikhoi Meetei na sengna khangnaba "KHUMAN" gi amuba machu asi karmna Hairaklibano,Oiraklibano haiba puya gi wafam sengna utchage Khetnaba puthokpiyu.

Salai 7 ki ahanba oiriba Mangang, Nula Epema Laikok huimulei puksi khompi na ayuki khonglei machuna ngangpa matamda, NaoSangta pokkhipana, nawa pu mangang mingthol fangcheiye.

Mathakki wafam asi eputhou konchin tukthapa pakhangpa gi macha nupa ahal "Mangang pokpagi matang puya da ebani. Mthangda amuk pakhngbgi macha Ani suba "Luwang pokpagi matangda puya gi wafam asi yengbiyu, Nula Epema Huimuleima na koilou mamina Wangna Nganna Yungpa Khonglei matamta Nawa na taipangpal faorakpana Luwang mingthol fangchaye.

Pakhangbagi macha Ahal amadi Anisuba pokpa matam gi machu asi ayukki khonglei machuna Ngangba matamta. Amadi wangna ngouna yungpa khonglei matam haibasi Mangang gi amasung Luwang gi, machu angangba amasung angouba machu louriba asi numit amasung malem anigi leinaba maridagi, mangal dagi Loukhibani.mangaldagi loukhiba machusing ni haiabasi erai laina khang-e. 

Mathangda KHUMAN gi machu oiriba Amuba asigi matangda puya da kari haina eri yengbiyu.

*Nula Epemma Loikhumpi Mawai Thongailelpi na koulou Mamina Khuna mampa mupa khonglei matamta, Naowa angangna taipangpal ta faolakpana Khuman Mingthol fangchaye. 

Mathakki puya dagi louthokpa asida yaoriba, Khuna, Mampa, Mupa hairiba sida #Khuna hairiba asigi wahanthokti apakpa nattaba, yamna Khuba makhul gumba, pot anigi marak karak kumbada, mamsu mamba musu muba haibani. BLACK haibasi english dictionary na, black colour : absence of colour hai. 

Maram asina KHUMAN na pokpa matam koilou mamina khuna mampa mupa khonglei matamta Hairibasi matamgi khonglei da numit (koilou numit) numit na BLACK HOLE amagi mathakta mapada chap yungna chatpa / lanba matamda, taipang malemda pokpani haiba nattana atei Karisu natte. Atei wahanthok ama piningai leite. matang asida aebana haijaribadi kangleicha meetei gi salai ahum suriba KHUMAN patriack asi numit ki mangalbu BLACK HoLe da chingsinkhiba matam da magal leitaba matamda pokpani haibani. Matamgi Science ki maramda khangba meesingna masidagi henna hainingai leite khlli. Khuman gi makha da salai patriack mari leihouri. Leihouriba mari asisu, Mangang, Luwang gumba numit mangal machugi gi manungda pokpani. Maram asina makhoigisu machu Lei, puya adum sengna eri.

#Wafam_Amana :- 

Numit (Sun) , Atingaa(space) amasung Malem (Earth) ahum asigi mari leinaba,
Malemgi Khonglei matam da atingaa (Space) gi manungda machu 7 lotuna lei haibasimadi puya kanglei Scripture da eriba asina arepa oina taklaga (written Evidence Oiraga) malemda masibu ahanba oina haikhiba mee kanglupti kangleipak ki meetei kanglup ni haibasimadi malem da kananasu yetpa ngamgani haibasi thajade. Black hole haiba asi physics ki Science na puthokpa wafam, Tingpalpa gi thoudok asi ehan hanna khangba malem gi mee kanglup asi kangleipak ki Meetei kanglup ni haina chaothokna Laothokli. 

Adubu masidagi kari hena haiba ngambage hairabadi haiba ngmde. Masigi maramdi puya pumnamk mei thakhibadagini. 18 suba chahi chada mayang (meeyan) ningthousing na thadokhraba, Meetei epa epu singna pairammi hairiba, Mthakta panjakhiba puya aduda eriba puya anigi maming:-
1. Koilou Numit Khenchanglon. 
2. Thouwaimichak Khenchanglon
puya ani asida soidana BLACK HOLE gi matang yaormgani.

## MEITEI CHEIRAOBA KAMDOUNA KANBA NGAMGANI.


MEITEI CHEIRAOBA' BU KARAMNA KANBA NGAMGANI?
Eikhoi Meeteigi Cheihi, Cheichat Numit-Tha paba (Era) asi Kanglei Puya gi matung 
enna Maliyapham Palcha ningthougi matamda hou_e haiibasi Kangleipakki pao-che, 
chephong (daily paper) kayada sijinnabata nattana, mee pumnamakna khangnaraba 
wafamni. Pao-che singgi matung inna, 
"Erai, Poinugi 20ni panba, Maliya Fambalcha 3419
Friday, 24th December 2021" 
nattraga
"Maliya Kumsing 3419, Poinu 20, Erai numit
Friday, the 24th December, 2021" 
asumna enari. Masina takpadi Meeteigi Kumhouba nattraga Cheihi houbana Christian 
Cheihidagi Cheihi (3419-2021=1398) halli haiiba khangi.
Meeteigi Kanglei ningthou Maliyapham Palcha haiiba ningthou asi Konchin Tukthapa 
Eepu Athoupa Pakhangpa gi masu, Eeputhou Pakhangpa dagi paraga marisuba 
ningthou, anisuba suthang, Saalai Leisangthem gi paring da pokpa ningthou ni.
Kanglei Meeteigi meeyamna Christagi mamang cheihi 1398 da Era puthoktuna kanglei 
meeyamna wanglaba khunnai ama oiduna pankhrababu Christagi Kum 1759-1798 da 
Kangleipakta meepai-thabaina pallamba hindu ningthou 
Chingthangkhomba/bheigyachandra na Kangleipak ta 'cheiraoba' haiina mingthonba, 
enou nouna semjinba thouram amana Meetei gi Cheihi houbani haiina karamna 
tambigadouribano?
MEETEI MEEYAM PANGTHABIGANU
'Cheiraoba', 'Cheilaopa'!
Masina karamna Meeteigi Cheihi houba, Kumhoubagi mahut singadouribano, 
nokningba wani!
'CHEIRAOBA' , 'CHEILAOPA' HAIIBASIGI MATANGDA
Meetei epa epu singna Kumhouba nattraga Cheihi houba haiidana 'cheilaopa' nattraga 
'sajibu cheiraoba' haiiramliba asigi wahanthok lei. 
Meetei Pathou, Sairem Nilbir na Huiyen Lanpao da tang 23/03/2012 da asumna erak_e 
- '(matonda sarik yanba chei asi leibak ningthou gi mangam shaktak khudam cheini)'
Chei matonda sarik yallaga sagol tongduna Pana marigi leirak khullakta "ngasidagi 
houna chahi ama houre" haina laowe haiina eikhoida takpiramliba/tambiramliba amadi 
"chei yaodana atoppa mawongda laoba yadra, kihanbagi mawong nattra" haiiba 
wahang asiga Kanglei Pathou Sairem Nilbir gi warengda 'chei na' 'leipak ningthougi 
matik mangam' takpani haiibasiga punna paminnabada cheiga konnana laobasi 
kihanbani haibasi tasengna khangi. Kihanbaga loinana, meeyamna yaningdaba cheihi 
houbagi mawong ama pusillakpani haiibasi khangi. Konthongda chak 
kat_hanba/thadok_hanba asisu 'cheiraoba' pangthoktaba/ningthou yathang 
indaba/anouba semjinba chatnabi waree asibu yaningdaba mee masak khangdoknaba 
hotnabagi thabakni. Cheihi houbaga konthongda chak thadokpaga mari suklei leinade. 
Meeteigidi Wakchingda Cheihi hou e. 
Poklakkadouriba angang adugi maruna mapada tha ani lei, masibu mapana naopuba 
kou_e. Ahanba thada nupa adugi Wakon, Wakonpung amasung Konching (Kok 
manung) da lei. Wakon, Wakonpung amasung Konching haiiba waheising asidagi Meetei gi ahanba thabu Wakching kou e. 
Wakon chingda leiramba taibang maruna taibang onnabagi mapung faba chaoraktuna 
mamada chatnanabagi sem saduna faiduna leirakpa thagi mamingbu Failel (Fairel) tha 
kou_e. Matam asida mapa oigadaba nupa adugi mamit naha ani longngi. 'Failel' thana 
Meeteigi anisuba Thani.
Puyana meegi (Nupee oibi singgi) masabu 'Leipak Ahingpi' kou_e. Angang maru 
aduna nupigi masada lakpa, tarakpabu lamda tare 'Lamta' tha kou_e. Meeteigi 
ahumsuba Thani. 
Houjikki 'Sajibu' haiiriba wahei asi Meeteigi asengba wahei 'Sachifu' haiba 
waheiidagi ollakpani, hindu matamda ontgokkhibani. Sachifu haibagi 
wahanthokti, Sachifu= Sa+Chi+Fu haiibadi Sa, Huksang (Hakchang), meeoiba 
oirakkadouriba mahee (semen with sperm) + Chi haiibadi chisillakpa, manungda 
changlakpa + Fu haiibadi mafam asida Fu haiiriba asi Chafu gumbani, 
tungnafamni. Mafam asidans nupeegi 'chalot' (womb) puni.
Meeteigi ahumsuba tha Lamta thada nupadagi angang maru yaoba mahi aduna Leipak 
Ahingpi da echai chaina tai. Tariba mahi adudagi 'Tillang' amana nupidagi ovum ga 
tinnaraba matungda, tha taramuk mamagi 'chalot' ta mee onnaba leinaba changsillak e. 
Masibu Kanglei Meetei ,na Sachifu tha kou_e. 
Meeteigi thachatlongi mamingdi meesemlon (embryology) dagi tholli. Meeteigidi 
Cheihi houbasi Wakching thadagi hou_e haiibasi Meeteigi Tha 12 gi wahoulon , wahei 
thoklapagi wahanthok (etymology) nasu tak_e. Sachifu thadi Meeteigi marisuba thani. 
Sachifu (sajibu) thada cheihi, Kum houba sukya yade. 
"Wakoklon Heelel Thilel Saalai Ama-ilon Pukok Puya" bu sindoklamba Angom 
Chaopana mahakna sindoklambagi warolda asumna eri -
"CHEIHIGI KUMHOU AHANPA NUMITTAGI SINTHOKPA HOUPANA NUMIT 
15 NI CHANGNA WAKCHINGKI THANINTA LOIYE"
Mathakki Chaopana haiiramliba asina haiiribadi, Cheihigi ahoupa numittagi sindokpa 
houbana numit 15 ni changna Wakching gi Thanin (Thanil!?!) da loi haiibani.
Masina Christagi 18 suba Cheihichagi a_eba khudam ama oina, Meeteidi Cheihi 
(chahi), Kumdi Wakching thadagi da hou_e hyribani. Sachifu (Sajibu) natte haiina 
sengna taklabani. Makhagi Meetei gini haiiriba, hindugi 'sajibu cheiraoba' gi seran 
turan touriba asi yengbiyu:
'Ngariyanbam Kulachandra Singh, pandit loishang, sanakonung' na eramba, 1969 da 
fongba Kanglei Ningthou chahi gi lairikki lamai 2/3 da eramliba asi yengbiyu:
'Mathel lukoi masing yamna thonglaga thongal khudinggi khara fandoktuna, wai 
ningthina teithoklaga heiruk pana thaomei sel numit adugi thongkhiba chaluk 3 
semduna katli, ...katliba thonganda thariba chakluk amata katpasu yao e. Aduga 
chakluk ahum katliba asidi onkhiba chahida cheiraokhiba numit adugi ama, kumsi 
chahigi cheiraoriba numit adugi ama, nongmeigi cheiraogadaba numit adugi ama, 
hairiba numit ahum asigidamakta katlaga, lukkhunbana erammaba tumaba, eram senba 
tusenba, kumsana kumlik lai. Arembana hanuba kokchaone, hannu leikhamne, 
khundahanbane asummakna phangjeiye.' 
Mathakki cheiraobada konthongda thadokpagi thouramda touriba pumnamakse 
khangdabana yenglaba, tarabadi chumlaboi ninglibani, adubu akhangba mee amana 
munna yenglaba, tarabadi chaokhattaba mapuksengdaba mee kangbu amana atoppa meeoiba kangbu amada touba hounadaba, lamchat chatpa adu sengna uiui. 
Mathakta chakluk ahum adubu katliba haiiriba lai ahum adudi: (1) Eeram Maba 
Tumaba (2) Eeram Senba Tusenba (3) Kumsana Kumlik Lai ni. Khangdaba meena 
yengba, taba matamdadi ahumsi lai oiraboi ningba yai. Adubu (1) gi hindu 
cheiraobagi lai 'Eeram Maba Tumaba' haiiba asida yaoriba wahei ahum -
Eeramaba+Tumaba waheising asigi waheigi hourakpham neinaduna yengsi: Eeram 
haiibadi Eelam, haiibadi esing lambi. Maba haiibadi khutna soklaga nanba nattraga 
tapna tapna paiiba. Tumaba haiibasi Maba haiibaduga mannei. Eeram haibasi 
kanagumbana ahanbagi We asi Eesing natte Ee (blood) ni haiina yetlakpa yai. Adu 
oirabadi Meitei cheiraoba gi lai 'eram maba tumaba' haiba lai asibu khongbangumba 
sengba laira nattraga meegi masada pukka suba lai oiba tai?
Anisuba lai 'Eeram Senba Tusenba' haiiba asigisu thoina haiiningai leite. Masisu 
choukidargumna eram khonglam sennaba lai oiba yai?
Ahumsuba lai 'Kumsana Kumlik Lai' haiiba wahei Ani asida yaoriba 'Kum' haiiba 
wahei/concept asigi wahanthok ti hujikki matamda 'chahi' haiiriba wahei aduni, 
karigumba matamda ariba lolda 'cheihi' hainasu sijinnei. 
Kumsana haibana ariba lolda chahi sandokpa haiibani aduga kumlik lai haiibana 
nong chudaba nong likpa chehigi lai haiibani, asigumba cheihida nong chunaba 'nong 
laoba' haiba thouramsu chattharam_e.
Mafam marang khangdana hourakpa manba waheising asina karamna "meitei 
cheiraobagi" laising oirakkhibano? Khanbada mam_e!
Kangleicha Meetei hi oina, Lukhaak pijei haiiriba lai ahum asigi wahanthok 
hourakpham amuk yengbiyu:
(1) Hanuba Kokchao - Tengpalpa semba mapu mahak adu Taibangpal asi mahakna 
sembanina, taipangpalpa asi leitringeidagi mamangda mahakna leirambana, 
taipangpalpagi thouwai panpa pumnamaktagi mahakna ehal halli haiiduna mahakpu 
Kangleicha eikhoina 'Hanupa', 'Hanuba' haiina kou_e. Tengpalpa, Tingpalpa, 
Taipangpalpagi pumnamakta leiriba achat-chatta pumnamak mahakki nungpung 
wakhaldagibu semlakpana, puthorakpana (mahakki KOKtagi thoklakpana) pumnamak 
asi taipang kanagi Kokta khanba ngamdabana, khuwaidagi pak chaona khanba 
ngamba Kok palli haiibadagi mahakki Kokpu 'Kokchao' kou_e. Maram asina 'Hanuba 
Kokchao' haiibadi taipang semba mapu mahakpu haiibani. 
(2) Hannu leikham : Hindu gi matamda 'Hannu Leikham' nattraga 'Hanuba Leikham' 
haiibada yaoriba 'Leikham' haiiba waheisi 'Laikham' haiibani, hindugi matamda 
'Leikham' haiina semdokkhibani. Wahanthok ti - Lai Akhamba, Laii Aroiba haiibadi 
Tengpalpa, Tingpalpa Mapu ( Universal Lord Creator ) haiibani.
(3) Khundahanba - Meeoibabu Taipangpalpa mapuna semlaba matungda, 
taipangpalpa da makhoina ehaan haanna macha masu poktuna pallakpabu khundaba 
nattraga khunthokpa kou_e. Taipangpalbada taibang meeoibana khunthok 
khundadringeida, mapu mahakna makhoibu semlaga khunthok khundahallakpa 
maramna, taipang semba mapu mahakpu Kangleicha singna 'Khunta Ahaanpa' / 
'Khunda Ahaanba' Khundahanba haiina khurumnei. Khunthok khundabadagi mahakna 
halli, haalli haiibani.
Mathakki lai ahum asi malem gi khwaidagi liraba Kangleichasinggi laisingni. Cheihi 
masing khangdana Kangleichasingna khurumduna laklaba laisingni. 'Khundahanba' lai asiga yamna wahanthok naknaba lai amana 'Mongbahanba' lai asini.
Cheihi lising kaya Kangleichasingna khurumjarakpa laisingbu, Christagi 18 suba, 19 
suba cheihichada changlakpa hindusingna, makhoina mafam marang khangdana 
semjinba sajinba laini haiiba kharagi aremmba lukhak chai haiibasi yamna hanthaba 
mawonggi sajatni.
A short note on:
NONGMA PANBA 'MEITEI SAJIBU CHEIRAOBA' GI MATANGDA
Sajibu nongma panba 'Meitei cheiraoba' haiiba thouram asi paksanna Meetei/Meitei 
singna cheihi houbagi thouram oina chattharakpa asida yamna chumboi khannaba, 
India ki president, Kangleipak (manipur)ki governor, chief minister nachingbasing, 
AIR nachingba kayana thouwai yamna yaosillak_e. Kangleipak (manipur) gi 
meeyambu Arjun gi macha masuni, Kangleipak asi thaiinagi 'Manipur' ni thajahanbada 
thujinnaba, Indianisation Mayangnisation toubada khara laina thoknaba, hindu gi 
meehutsingna seeng yangsillak_e, kanna-kanna mei humkatlak_e.
Eikhoina munna amuktang yengsi! Meeteigi yelhoungeigi Lailelpee Eema Eemoinu 
eeratpanachingba, Kangleipak (manipur) ki governor na chingbana karigi amukta 
'Yaifa paojel' piraktribano, ateigidi piraga?
Eikhoi khangngi.
'Sajibu cheiraoba', sajibu nongma panbada cheihi houba thouram asi Kanglei Meeteigi 
yelhoungeigi Cheihi Kum houbagi thouram sungnat natte! Thouramgi maming asinasu 
Sajibu(Sachifu) thagi wahanthok, wahoulon amadi thokkhiba thokliba thouthok sing 
asinasu Meeteigi yelhoungeigi cheihi houbagi thouram nattre haiba sengna khangngi. 
Ahal eebungo, Nongkakhalapa, Laioikhalapa Eepa Wangkhemcha Chingtamlen 
(A_ebana) tamthokpiramba makhagi thouram/wafam asi taseng tasengna 
thokkhiba thoudokni.
"Christagi Cheihi Kumsing 1971 da sajibu nongma panba 'meitei cheiraoba' gi chahi 
houbagi thouram asi houkhibani"
Haiiriba matam asida, a_ebana khuwaidagi nakna tinnajakhiba ahalsingdi - (1) 
FRIEND'S TALKIES KI PROPRIETOR LAISHRAM MANAOBI, (2) 
MAYANGLAMBAM APABI, KEISHAMTHONG, (3) HAOBAM KULABIDHU, 
SAGOLBAN, (4) SAWAIJAM RUHINIKUMAR, YAISKUL, (5) YUMNAM 
BUDHICHANDRA, PISHUMTHONG, (6) THOKCHOM THOUKACHANPA, 
SAGOLBAN, (7) OKRAM NITYAI, THANGMEIBAND, (8) TOKPAM 
THAWAILENPA, HODAM LEIRAK, (naharolgi marakta). Mayamsi sanamahee 
chatpa ngaktani. Mathakki ahalsing asi a_ebadagi cheihi 10 gi mathakta hanba 
ngaktani. Loina leikhidre. Eingondagi naha oiba Thouwailenpata ngaihoure.
Mathakki ahalsing gi ming parengda (2) da yaoriba Mayanglambam Apabi hairiba ahal 
ebungosi Imphal Municipal gi member su oiram e.
Mathakki ming ejakhraba ahalsing amasung naha khara asi matam ayambada Friend's 
Talkies Hall da famduna Meeteisinggi maramda khannaduna matam lelli.
Christagi cheihi 1971 gi anganba matamda, numidangwairamgi ahalsing asigi meefam 
amada, cheiraoba gi matangda khannarakpada mathakta ming panjakhraba ahal ebungo 
Mayanglambam Apabi na hindusingna sajibu cheiraoba hairaga sajibu mayaidagi chahi houjinba asi lalli, houba haibadi 1(ama) dagi hougadabani, sajibu nongma panbada 
houbana chum_e haina houdorakkhi. Hall da ahalsing amadi nahasing aduna meefam 
aduda ahal ebungo Mayanglambam Apabi na houdorakpa wafam adu yanakhi. 
Yanakhibagi matung enna 1971 gi cheiraoba di sajibu nongma panbada pangthoklagani 
haiina lepnakhi.
Lepnakhiba matung enna 1971 gi sajibu nongma panbagi nungthil pung 3 lom tabada 
ahal ebungo Laishram Manaobi na luchingladuna ahal naha nupa nupi kayana Band 
Party yaona Mike na 'Ngasidagi chahi houre' haiiduna laora laoraduna cheiraoching 
karakkhi. Chingdonda thabalsu chongkhi. Mathakta ming panjakhraba Tokpam 
Thouwailenpa masamak thabal chongba yao e, numit aduda sijinnakhiba Mike adu 
mahakna waikhibani haiina ayibada haiibiram_e.
Matou asumna sajibu nongma panba 'meitei cheiraoba asidi 1971 da houdokkhibani'. 
Meeteigi yelhoungeigi Cheihi/Kum houbagi thouram natte.

#![article-thumbnail-200kb.jpg](images/article-thumbnail-200kb.jpg)
# MEETEI YUMCHAO TA LAININGTHOU 

Kangleicha meetei eikhoigi thainagi 'meetei yumchao' haina khangnaba leinaba 
yumjao asi ahingba laishangni. Ahingba laishang 'yumchao' asigi manungda yamna maru 
oiba lai ahumgi khupham(leipham) lei.
Ahanba laiphamna, yumchaogi yet thangba nakanda ahanba yum adu urep(jatra) 
makhong lei, masida Lainingthou salailel sitapa (epa sorarel) gi khupham (leipham) ni. 
Mapham asida esaiphu khingani.
Anisuba laiphamna, lainingthou salailel sitapa gi mapa chap chana yumchao gi oi 
thangba nakanda ema leimalel sitapi gi khupham (leipham) lei. Mapham asida leimalel sitapi 
ema gi pheeke phanek,ennaphi thamduna khurumgani. 
Aduga masiha loinana, sanamahee lainingthou gi emung kachingi 
mapangi saruk, moilang laichigi mapangi chithek adubu 'santhong' 
'sanathong' hairaga khangnei. 'Santhong', nattraga 'sanathong' gi 
wahanthok ti mee santhokpa haibani. 
Kangleicha meeteisinggu wangulonda, meeteigi yumchao asi numit, 
tha, thouwaimichak, malem asinachingba achat chatta pumnamak 
yaoriba nongthou, ating-ah, salailel sitapa, epa sorarel (space) asigi 
mahut sinduna sabani.
Eikhoina houjik sijinnariba wahei 'Emung' hairiba wahei asigi 
wahanthok ti 'Ee manung' haibani. Taipang semnaba ee(blood) 
adubu yao e haibani.

EPUNGLOINAPA APAKPA GI SAKTAM(SYMBOL) ꯱•(AMA) ASI KARINO?

Tingpalpa mapu epungloinapa apakpa mahakna taipangpalpa semba pirakpada mapu 
mahakki masak asi "꯱•" (ama) oina utlakpani amasung nupagi saktam louriba 'lainingthou 
salailel sitapa' da mahak haibadi mahakki mahutsinba saktam "꯱•" asibu nachamakni khanna 
'yoklo' haina paotak pirakpani. 
Masigi matungda, lainingthou salailel sitapa na mahakki Masada yaoriba 'sanaki 
masak malpa nouwa ꯱• (ama)' adubu sanamahee mingthol piduna ema leimalel sitapi da 
pisillaga, ema leimalel sitapi na louraga konsinbada 'pali apanpa 
konseng tulei sengpa' sanamahee lainingthou oirakpani.
Puyagi wapham pumnamak asina, houjik eikhoina yumgi sanamahee kachin da 
latliba, khurumliba lai asi 'sanamahee lainingthou' ni haibadi tingpalpa mapu mashak leitaba, 
epungloinapa apakpa mahakni. Saktam(symbol) na saktam ꯱• asini. Eikhoina sanamahee 
lainingthou haiba mamingda khurumbani.

Saktam(symbol) asi karino? 

Eikhoina hanna khangkhare madudi tingpalpa gi mapu, epungloinapa apakpa mahakti 
'talang epung' gi mapu ni haibani. 'Talang epung' haibadi ee(blood) ngaktana talang tarang 
oina leiba haibani. Maram asina saktam ꯱• asina taklibadi tingpalpa mapu epungloinapa 
apakpa aduna taipangpalpa meeoibana chingba uli wali, sa uchek pumnamak puthoknaba, 
semnaba taipangki mapa mahakna saktam ꯱• asi oina taipang da thouwaipanba pumnamak 
semnaba taipang malemda ahanba oina khongdarakpani.

Sanamahee lainingthou gi saktam(symbol) di ꯱• asini. Thainadagi houna sanamahee 
kachin da epa epusingna latlamva saktamni. 
Science ki mityengda sanamahee:
Uli wali, pikkhraba thouwaipanba dagi mee, sa, pumnamak, chaoraba samu phaoba 
thouwai panba achat chatta pumnamak ki Gene(DNA) asi amatani. 
Gene(DNA) amakhaktadagi semgatlakpani, meetei gi thainagi science ki matung 
enna. Amata oiba gene(DNA) adudi meetei na ningsingba ngamdraba matamdagi latlakliba 
sanamahee lainingthou aduni. Saktam(symbol) na ꯱• asini.
Atoppa science ki wapham amana, 
Tingpalpa mapu epungloinapa apakpa na, mahak taipangpalpa semba laklage, numit 
humni suba nouwa ama oina leilamke, haina talang laipao piramliba asina takpadi, malem 
taipangda pallipa, thouwaipalpa pumnamakki thouwaising asi nongmaton thaktagi lakpani, 
Extra-terrestrial origin of life ki mapung phaba lousingni, kangleicha meeteisingna malemgi 
mee pumnamaktagi scientific fact asi hanna khang e haibasini.haibasini.

Wakoklon_Hilel_Thilel_Salai_Ama_Ilon_pukok masigi maming asigi wahanthok karino haibasi eikhoi khangminnasi 

Puya asigi manunggi warol khangbidringai puya asigi maminggi wahanthok hanna khangba tangai fade puya asibu masak khangsi hairabadi.


WAKOKLON+HILEL+THILEL+SALAI+AMA-I-LON+PUKOK

Wakoklon=Wa+kok+lon.(Wa=concept/word,kok=Head/Process of creation,Lon=Languages)
Hilel=Khawaidagi henba(Held in the highest esteem.)
Thilen=Thi+Lel(Thi=Thijinba/thiba,Lel=khwaidagi henba(Highest form of analysis or reasearch),
Salai=Sa+Lai(Sa=Body+Lai=God.)
Ama-i-lon=word of the one,
Pukok=Pumnamakpu kokpiriba (i.e. the creator or the one who brings forth of everthing.).
Yaifare.
